Join and leave notifications work on Minecraft 26.x. Recent versions log joins as `System chat: Steve joined the game`, which Flytower didn't recognise, so no join or leave notifications were sent and the public status page missed who was online. To get them, tick **A player joined** and **A player left** on a notification channel in **System → Notifications**.

Testing: join and leave a 26.x server, and check that each notification arrives within a second and that the status page lists you while you're on.
